name: srm-enterprises
description: SRM Enterprises — industrial packaging material supplier website (Next.js frontend + Express API + MongoDB Atlas + Resend email).

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @srm/api && npm run build --workspace @srm/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @srm/api && npm run lint --workspace @srm/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @srm/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @srm/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @srm/web
